1651-2638-5334-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-5334-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-5334-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

4131-4779-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4131-4779-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-3286-7060.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1008-1978-5517.easyPrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it

2111-2981-4981.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2187-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Possessed Skaab.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from exile to the battlefield.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

997-1303-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1987-4311-4423-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1987-4311-4423-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

2043-3621-6798.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4365-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

772-997-3175.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

650-2438-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

772-891-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

813-6103-6492-7309.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1978-5143-7203.description:
Cause Brigid to become an artifact using Transmogrifying Licid. 
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brigid.
Repeat from step 2.

3713-3755-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3459-3755-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3534-3967-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3534-3967-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

1456-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

560-2457-4289-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Soldier by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1978-5143-5457.easyPrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
1978-5143-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-5143-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

3693-4613-6774-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Loading Zone.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

907-4826-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4826-5451-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

305-1323-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Llanowar Tribe's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

413-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-5968-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

149-220-3457.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Seeker of Skybreak triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to any target.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

101-4002-4067-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
101-4002-4067-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

360-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
360-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Soul Warden indestructible.
360-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1657-2486.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to your commander.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander.
Repeat from step 2.

81-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
81-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

77-997-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1809-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Returned Pastcaller each turn.
1809-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Returned Pastcaller by paying its mana cost.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Returned Pastcaller from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

527-2921-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-2921-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-2921-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Selvala, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-2921-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2137-5352.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands, at least one of which enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
2137-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targetting two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying Doppelgang, targeting the land and another permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of the land and two copies of the other permanent.
Activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning the two token lands to your hand, copying Doppelgang, targeting the land and another permanent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5256-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5256-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Lazotep Convert's power.
Repeat from step 4.

1981-3629-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
1981-3629-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2661-3327.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2034-2661-3327.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1651-1737-2034-2637-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles.
1651-1737-2034-2637-4840.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mechtitan Core.
Activate the Mechtitan Core token by paying {5} and exiling it, Myr Battlesphere, and any three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles, creating a 10/10 Mechtitan creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mechtitan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Mechtitan core token triggers, returning all other cards exiled by it to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-2440-2645.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Insects.
1339-2440-2645.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's last ability by paying {5} and tapping it, causing yourself to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, causing you to add at least six {C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

404-1521-1879-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-1879-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

2741-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
2741-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Essence Warden and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
